candidate_relations.reason: The clinical record strongly suggests recurrence or metastasis of the patient's prior laryngeal squamous cell carcinoma (or less likely bladder urothelial carcinoma) to the pacemaker pocket site. 'Metastatic disease to pacemaker pocket' correctly identifies the anatomical event and is consistent with the reference diagnosis of squamous cell carcinoma, but it omits the required histological subtype (squamous cell carcinoma) that constitutes the full diagnostic object. It is a parent/mechanism descriptor rather than the complete equivalent.
